source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of primary sources (PDF 185-186).

blocks.text: Primary sources (bunyadi ya asal maakhaz) woh asal mawad hai jis mein koi tabdeeli nahi ki gayi.
Misal: Jin scientists ne tehqeeq ki, un ka khud likha hua research paper primary source hai. Is ke muqable mein kisi aur ka likha hua us tehqeeq ka khulasa (summary) secondary source hoga.

blocks.prompt: Nayi tehqeeq par akhbar ki khabar primary source hai ya secondary?
blocks.explanation: Secondary source, kyunke yeh asal research paper nahi balke kisi aur ka likha hua us ka khulasa hai.

items: Primary source: asal, tabdeel na kiya hua mawad (scientists ka research paper); secondary: kisi aur ka khulasa.
